name: Tres Palacios Copano Interconnect
researcher_notes: Not on the roster. The EIA August 2026 pipeline projects workbook, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 747, lists Tres Palacios Copano Interconnect: a lateral by Tres Palacios Gas Storage LLC, completed, in service 23 May 2013, 19.7 miles (about 31.7 km, above the 25 km rule), 24 inch, 400 MMcf/d added capacity, FERC docket CP12-36, Texas. The Jan 2024 release carries the same row. Only EIA was found: web search was unavailable, so no FERC order or operator release was checked. EIA is one origin, so confidence is medium. Exact endpoints are not in EIA; the name suggests Tres Palacios Gas Storage (Matagorda County) to a Copano facility, but that is not sourced, so start and end locations are left blank. Needs a FERC order or Copano interconnect source and route research. Existing row P7835 Cougar Lateral is a different proposed line; P0198 Coastal Bend Header is a different system. Owner name already in the entity gazetteer style.
